questions.question: Sami asks Mina: 'What is the key to a good orthodontic diagnosis?' Mina replies:
options: A complete assessment: clinical, cephalometric, and radiological
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Orthodontic diagnosis is based on a complete clinical, cephalometric, and radiological assessment.' 🦅 Sami: 'Fine, I'll do the whole assessment... but it's long!'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How do you evaluate a child's growth?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Cervical vertebral maturation (CVM) is the best indicator of residual growth.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will learn to read CVM.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is the Bolton method?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The Bolton method calculates crowding and guides the decision between extraction and expansion.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will always calculate the Bolton.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What is the curve of Spee?' Mina replies:
options: The sagittal occlusal curve of the teeth
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The curve of Spee is an important occlusal parameter. A deep curve > 2 mm is often associated with a Class II.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will measure the curve of Spee systematically.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What are the key cephalometric parameters?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The key parameters include SNA, SNB, ANB, FMA, and IMPA to evaluate skeletal relationships.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will learn all these parameters.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What is overjet?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Overjet is the horizontal distance between the upper and lower incisors.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will measure my patients' overjet.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is overbite?' Mina replies:
options: The vertical overlap of upper incisors over lower incisors
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Overbite is the vertical overlap of upper incisors over lower incisors.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will measure overbite systematically.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'When should a panoramic X-ray be taken in orthodontics?' Mina replies:
options: Only in case of suspected impaction
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The panoramic X-ray is essential to evaluate tooth germs, impactions, and pathologies.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will always prescribe a panoramic X-ray.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is lateral cephalometry?' Mina replies:
options: A standardized profile X-ray for cephalometric analysis
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Lateral cephalometry is a standardized profile X-ray for analysis of skeletal relationships.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will always take a cephalogram.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How do you evaluate skeletal maturity?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Cervical vertebral maturation is the best indicator of skeletal maturity.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will learn to read CVM.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What are the signs of a skeletal Class II?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'A skeletal Class II is characterized by ANB > 4° and a low SNB.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will calculate the ANB systematically.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What are the signs of a skeletal Class III?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'A skeletal Class III is characterized by ANB < 0° and a high SNB.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will always check the ANB.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is the Nolla space?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The Nolla space evaluates the stage of development of teeth, particularly canines.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use the Nolla space for impacted canines.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'When should a tooth be extracted in orthodontics?' Mina replies:
options: Only in cases of severe crowding > 6-8 mm
Never, expansion should always be done
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Extractions are indicated for severe crowding > 6-8 mm.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will calculate the crowding before extracting.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is retention in orthodontics?' Mina replies:
options: The post-treatment phase to stabilize the results
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Retention is the essential post-treatment phase to stabilize the results.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will always plan for retention.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What are the advantages of aligners?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Aligners offer superior aesthetics, comfort, and hygiene.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will propose aligners to my patients.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What are the limits of aligners?' Mina replies:
options: Limited for complex movements and severe rotations
They only work for simple cases
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Aligners have limits for complex movements and severe rotations.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use braces for complex cases.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What is a mini-screw in orthodontics?' Mina replies:
options: A temporary implant for orthodontic anchorage
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Mini-screws are temporary implants for orthodontic anchorage.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use mini-screws for anchorage.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is orthognathic surgery?' Mina replies:
options: Surgery to correct severe skeletal malocclusions
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Orthognathic surgery corrects severe skeletal malocclusions.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will refer patients to surgeons.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What are the risk factors for relapse in orthodontics?' Mina replies:
options: Lack of retention, residual growth, parafunctions
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Relapse is multifactorial: insufficient retention, growth, parafunctions.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will prevent relapse with good retention.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is the Downs method in cephalometry?' Mina replies:
options: A cephalometric analysis of facial angles
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Downs' analysis evaluates facial angles and dental inclinations.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use Downs' analysis.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a dental agenesis in orthodontics?' Mina replies:
options: Space closure or preservation for implant
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The strategy depends on the location and the occlusion.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will plan the management of agenesis.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is maxillary expansion?' Mina replies:
options: A technique to widen the maxilla (quad-helix, disjunctor)
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Maxillary expansion is indicated for crossbites and crowding.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will propose expansions.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What are the risks of excessive orthodontic forces?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Excessive forces can cause fractures, recessions, and resorptions.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use adapted forces.'

questions.question: Sami, after having mastered orthodontic diagnosis with Mina, says: 'I am ready to take on all challenges!' Mina concludes: 'Mastering orthodontic diagnosis is...'
options: The basis of success in orthodontics
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Mastering orthodontic diagnosis is the basis of success in orthodontics.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will continue to train.'
